## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6306-action-icon-type-resolution.md`

- names `action-icon.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Scope is this one renderer. `type: schema` appears in exactly two files under `renderers/action/` — `action-button.tsx` (already correct) and `action-icon.tsx`; `action:group` and `action:menu` compose their members differently and are untouched.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `4215ed76b` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1310 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1882 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36043907396)

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (all at the review tier). Adopted by this seat. Seat note: the one run still in progress at the reviewer's last poll (`Spec Main Shape Gate`) completed `success` before this record was posted; 43 check-runs, 40 success, 3 skipped by design.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Diff surface verified.** `git diff 1dbb9933cc..3b6341b608` (merge-base with `origin/main`, which contains PR #10272 as `978507b9a`) is exactly 3 files, +284/-0: `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx` (+22: one import, one comment block, one `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, isVisible, handleClick);` call), `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-icon-autotrigger.test.tsx` (+240, new), `.changeset/10274-action-icon-auto-trigger.md` (+22, new). `auto-trigger.ts` is not edited. `git diff --check` clean. The PR body's "base `1dbb993`" is the merge-base.
- **Hook placement obeys the rules of hooks.** At head, `action-icon.tsx` calls `useAction` (l.90), `useState` (l.91), `usePredicateRecordContext` (l.94), `useCondition` x3 (l.96, 101, 102), `useCallback` (l.108) and `useAutoTriggerOnce` (l.201) unconditionally, and the renderer's only early return is `if (hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(schema.visible) && !isVisible) return null;` at l.207, below the hook. Same shape as `action-button.tsx` (hook l.291, early return l.298).
- **Exactly once per mount.** Once-ness is the hook's own `fired` ref (`auto-trigger.ts` l.152, l.157, l.171), not anything the icon wrote; the icon adds no second guard. The dev's uncommitted probe that a full unmount/remount with the flag still set runs again is what the hook documents ("one ref per rendered action, for the lifetime of that action's component") and matches `action:button`. On the card's path the host drops the flag after the first commit: `useConsumeOnce` (`useNavRunAction.ts` l.73-88 at head) sets `consumed.current = true` in its effect and returns `null` from then on, so `ObjectView.tsx` l.1481-1486 maps the action back without `autoTrigger`. Verified in code, consistent with the report.
- **Run path is the click path.** The hook receives `handleClick`, the same `useCallback` the button's `onClick={handleClick}` (l.242) uses; it builds one `ActionDef` (`type: schema.actionType`, `confirmText`, `params`, `toast`, `resultDialog`, `onSuccess`, ...) and calls `execute({ ...forwarded, ...localContext })`. Confirm, params dialog and toasts therefore live in the runner, downstream of both entry points. `action-button.tsx` passes its own `handleClick` the same way. Pinned by the new test's `toEqual` on the two recorded defs (row 3) and the declined-`confirmText` row (row 4: `onConfirm` called once with `'Really create?'`, handler never called).
- **Refusal notice identical to #10272's.** Nothing icon-specific: the notice is emitted inside the shared hook (`t('actions.notAvailableHere', ...)`, sonner id `auto-trigger-refused:<name>`, dev `console.warn` naming the action and predicate and citing objectui#4191). The key exists in all 10 locale packs at head (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). The test pins one toast containing `Create icon`, exactly one diagnostic containing `create_icon`, zero executions, with an ungated sibling button present so "not run" is not "nothing mounted".
- **Fail-soft vs fail-closed: recorded, not a FAIL.** Fact: the icon's `isVisible` is `useCondition(toPredicateInput(schema.visible), recordData)` with no `throwOnError` (l.96), while button/menu pass `{ throwOnError: true }`. `useExpression.ts` l.215-240 confirms the non-throwing leg returns the evaluator's plain verdict (header l.110-111: "the non-throwing legs fail soft to `true`"). This is pre-existing and pinned as-is by `action-record-predicate-root.test.tsx` l.244-250 ("`visible` keeps its EXISTING fail-soft policy on a faulting predicate" / "Not what this PR decides") and tabled in `action-template-predicate-gate.test.tsx` l.23 and `SITES` (`action:icon`, `failClosed: false`). Judgment against the texts: (a) the hook's enforced `@param isVisible` contract is "the renderer's own evaluated `visible` verdict, the same value its early return consults"; the icon feeds exactly that, so the trigger can never disagree with what the icon renders, which is the invariant the hook exists to hold. (b) Ruling A (comment 5812953871) requires: author's `visible` outranks the flag when it evaluates not-visible; refusal reported, not swallowed; button and menu consistent; the preparation step checks `visible` so a hidden action does not spend the intent. It does not rule on the error policy of a throwing predicate. (c) The `auto-trigger.ts` header parenthetical "(the same fail-closed `useCondition` it already computes for its early return)" (l.74-75) describes what button/menu already computed; it is prose about those two, not the parameter contract, and the same file's header also says the icon's early return and the hook must consult one value. (d) Reachability on the card's path: `useOfferedNavRunAction` evaluates the candidate's `visible` fail-closed (`throwOnError: true`, l.166-169) before arming, so a `?runAction=` deep link to an icon whose predicate throws is refused by the host and never flagged; the icon's fail-soft verdict cannot be reached through the landing site this card names. The only other `autoTrigger` producer is `EnvironmentListToolbar` (`create_environment` via the unchanged `useNavRunAction`, no `visible` check, a gap #10272's report already recorded), reachable only if that action were authored `component: 'action:icon'` with a throwing predicate. Not a contradiction of the ruling or of the enforced contract; the dev surfaced it honestly. Follow-up worth a card: `auto-trigger.ts` l.70-75 and `useNavRunAction.ts` l.122 still name two consumers and "fail-closed", which is now a stale description for the third; both files are outside the claimed surface, so leaving them was the correct call here.
- **New changeset, sentence by sentence, TRUE at head.** "renders each inline action with the renderer its `component` names": `action-bar.tsx` l.299-300 (`action.component || 'action:button'`, `ComponentRegistry.get`). "reached `action:icon` with the host's `autoTrigger` flag on it, and `action:icon` ignored the flag": the bar spreads `...action` onto the child schema (l.306-312); base `action-icon.tsx` has no `autoTrigger`/hook reference (the diff adds the only ones). "consumed (removed from the URL) and ran nothing, with no notice": `useConsumeOnce` strips the param once the candidate is present and not hidden, without regard to `component`. "runs the action once, through its own click handler, so confirm dialogs, parameter dialogs and toasts apply exactly as they do on a click. Re-renders do not run it again": hook + `handleClick`, pinned by rows 3, 4, 5. "If the action's own declared `visible` hides the icon, the action is not run. A warning toast names the action, and development builds log a console diagnostic, as the other two renderers do": hook l.158-170, pinned by row 7. The lead sentence "the same way `action:button` and `action:menu` do" is true of the mechanism (one shared hook); the only divergence is the pre-existing render-policy edge above, which the changeset does not claim to change.
- **Pending `4191-autotrigger-honours-visible.md`** (still on `origin/main` and at head): says "`action:button` and `action:menu` refuse ... Both go through the one shared hook, so which renderer received the action (decided by `action:bar`'s `maxVisible`, and so by the viewport) cannot change the outcome." It names two and asserts no exclusivity; every sentence remains true after this diff. The dev's wording claim is verified.
- **Pending `6306-action-icon-type-resolution.md`** (flagged by the claim-re-read bot for the paragraph "Scope is this one renderer. `type: schema` appears in exactly two files under `renderers/action/` ..."): `git grep -l "type: schema"` under `renderers/action/` returns the identical three files at base and head (`action-button.tsx`, `action-icon.tsx`, and the pre-existing `__tests__/action-bar-member-type-resolution.test.tsx`); the new test file does not contain the string. No sentence is made false by this diff. The stale `schema.actionType || schema.type` quote the dev noted predates this PR (objectui#7415) and is not this diff's doing.
- **Pins real and able to fail.** Rows 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 reach the handler, the confirm mock or the toast spy only through the hook call; with the line removed, `waitFor` on each times out (row 1 would read `['create_button']` alone). Row 2 (unflagged icon runs nothing) is the one row green in both worlds, exactly the 7 failed / 1 passed the dev reports on base and under ablation. `maxVisible: 10, mobileMaxVisible: 10` keeps the icon inline so the menu cannot be the executor. Renderer imported by relative path, no build leg. I did not re-run the suite (forbidden); the dev's measurements are consistent with the code.
- **PR body A4 claim** (`action:menu` / `action:group` as inline members render nothing): consistent with `action-menu.tsx` l.300 `if (actions.length === 0) return null;` for a member spread without `actions`. Reported out of scope, not changed here; fine.

Evidence: the only source change is one hook call inside an existing renderer; no export added, moved or removed; no registry `inputs`/`defaultProps` change; no declared key or schema change; `auto-trigger.ts` untouched; no other package touched. It is a behaviour fix for a silent no-op on an existing flag, same level as the precedent #10272 changeset. Not major.
